depth_justification: Strongly engages BumpGuide's actual disclosures (IDFA/Android ad ID, Firebase, LMP/birth date/symptoms/kick counts, ad-network device IDs) with mostly correct precise citations (ePrivacy Art. 5(3), EDPB Guidelines 2/2023, GDPR Art. 9 and Art. 5(1)(b)/(c), Swiss DPA), but a verbatim-repeated turn pair and inconsistent/mislabeled HERA dimension IDs hold it back.
actionability_justification: Several concrete, implementable steps (block all non-essential trackers/SDKs until explicit consent, maintain an SDK/tracker inventory with ePrivacy exemption status, separate ad targeting onto non-health data, opt-out for non-essential collection) plus the requested severity-grouped report, though some items stay directional.
salient_examples: ePrivacy Directive Article 5(3): Requires prior consent before accessing or storing information on a user's device [eprivacy_terminal]
Block non-essential trackers until consent... Do not fire any non-essential trackers (e.g., ad networks, Firebase) until explicit consent is obtained
Separate ad targeting from health data: Use non-health data... for ad targeting and monetization
Turn 3 and turn 4 assistant responses to 'Email, LMP date...' are identical verbatim
